 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 13 03-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties 2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in Special Case No. 06 of 2017 arising out of R.C. 08(A)
of 2017 registered under Sections 120(B), 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC read with 13(2), 13(1)(d) of the PC Act, 1988.

3. As per the prosecution case, the officials of Indian Overseas Bank, in conspiracy with the borrowers/dealers, sanctioned and disbursed term loan and CC facility to the tune of Rs. 378.77 lakhs to undeserving and non-existent borrowers on the basis of forged and fake documents and thereby cheated by causing undue loss to the bank.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is neither the bank official nor the borrower.
He is Patna High Court CR.

sentences.text: 1 party dealing in plants and machinery and he used to supply equipment to the borrowers.
The petitioner is a person of clean antecedent.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Indian Overseas Bank has submitted that the bank loan amount was credited to the account of the petitioner for supply of machinery etc.

6. Learned counsel for the CBI has filed a counter affidavit and paragraph 18 and 19 of the counter affidavit is being extracted hereinbelow:-
" 18.

That furthermore it is most humbly submitted CBI is not indending to oppose the anticipatory bail petition of the accused in the light of Supreme Court order passed in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. CBI, (2021) 10 SCC 773, and the Supreme Court order dated 17.01.2025 in the matter of Musheer Alam Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh in SLP (Crl. No. 18081 of 2024)
19.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. CBI, (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Musheer Alam Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh in SLP (Crl. No. 18081 of 2024)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: That in view of the submissions made hereinabove and in light of the recent Supreme Court orders referred to in paragraph 18, while the CBI does not intend to oppose the anticipatory bail petition of the accused, however, it is most respectfully submitted that the accused must be directed to cooperate fully and participate sincerely in the ongoing investigation and not tamper with evidence or witnesses and not leave the country without prior intimation and permission from the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65321 of 2024(13) dt.03-12-2025 CBI or Hon'ble Court.
The accused should not misuse the liberty granted by this Hon'ble Court and must remain available for interrogation and other procedural requirements as mandated by law.
It is further most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may impose such conditions as it deems fit to ensure the proper and expeditious conduct of the investigation."

Learned counsel for the CBI submits that in the light of averments made in paragraph 18 and 19 of the counter affidavit, CBI is not intending for custodial interrogation of the petitioner but he should fully cooperate with the investigation.

Learned counsel for the petitioner, in reply, submits that he would fully cooperate the investigating agency and he will make himself physically present as and when required by the investigating agency.

sentences.text: In case, any of the following conditions is flouted by the petitioner, it would make him disentitled from the benefit of provisional bail and his provisional bail shall liable to be cancelled.
9. Learned counsel for the CBI shall furnish further details of investigation including the co-operation of the petitioner in investigation.

10. List the matter on 08.02.2025, retaining its position.
(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) priyanka/-
